name: ISST: dual-bias attention + spectral residual
tagline: Transformer encoder with per-head distance-decay and observed-position attention biases, mask-projection conditioning, and a learnable rFFT residual head.
formula: $$ \text{score}^{(h)}_{ij} = \frac{Q^{(h)}_i K^{(h)\top}_j}{\sqrt{d_k}} - s^{(h)}\,\log(1 + |i - j|) + b^{(h)}\,r_j $$ $$ r_j = \tfrac{1}{C}\sum_c \mathrm{mask}_{jc},\quad h_{\text{out}} = h + \mathrm{irFFT}(\mathrm{rFFT}(h)\odot W),\;\; W = W_r + i\,W_i\;\;(W_r, W_i \text{ init } 0) $$

key_hyperparams.name: spectral filter
key_hyperparams.value: (W_r, W_i) zero init, complex shape (1, n_freq, d)

key_hyperparams.name: mask_proj
key_hyperparams.role: encode binary mask into embedding space

init_recovers: Vanilla transformer encoder (spectral filter is zero-init no-op)
diff_from_baseline: Versus timesnet/patchtst this swaps the temporal block for a transformer with two attention biases tied to imputation (log-distance preference and observed-position preference) plus a frequency-domain residual head; mask-aware (z-score on observed entries) normalization is reused.

name: Per-variable embed + cross-var attention + temporal Tx
tagline: Embed each (t, c) scalar separately, mix across variables with attention, run a temporal Conv+Transformer on flattened seq*var tokens, then project per-variable.

key_hyperparams.name: MaskConditionedNorm
key_hyperparams.role: modulate LN affine by mask density

init_recovers: Vanilla transformer if conv, var-attn, and refine are zeroed
diff_from_baseline: Versus dlinear/timesnet/patchtst this builds a 4D (B, T, C, d) tensor and applies a cross-variable attention plus a temporal Conv+Transformer over flattened (t*c) tokens, with a mask-density-conditioned LN affine.

name: Mask-aware PatchTST with iterative refinement
tagline: Channel-independent PatchTST whose patch embedding concatenates value and mask patches; runs the encoder twice, refilling masked positions with first-pass predictions.
init_recovers: PatchTST (channel-independent) at num_iterations=1 and zero step embedding
diff_from_baseline: Versus the patchtst baseline this concatenates the value patch with a same-shape mask patch before the patch-Linear, adds a learnable step embedding per iteration, and runs the encoder twice with first-pass predictions filling masked entries.

name: BMDI: bidirectional fill + tiny refiner
tagline: No transformer: forward+backward exponentially smoothed propagation with three sigmoid-decay rates, a softmax-fusion MLP over their outputs and confidences, and a 3-layer MLP residual on missing positions only.
formula: $$ f_t = m_t x_t + (1 - m_t)((1-\alpha) f_{t-1} + \alpha x_t),\quad b_t = m_t x_t + (1 - m_t)((1-\alpha) b_{t+1} + \alpha x_t) $$ $$ v_k = \tfrac{1}{2}(f^{(\alpha_k)} + b^{(\alpha_k)}),\;\;\alpha_k = \sigma(\theta_k),\;\theta_{\text{init}} = (0, 0.7, 1.4) $$ $$ w = \mathrm{softmax}(\mathrm{MLP}([v_1, v_2, v_3, c_1, c_2, \bar m])),\quad \hat x = \sum_k w_k v_k + (1-m)\,\mathrm{MLP}([\hat x, v_2, w_2, m, |\hat x - v_2|]) $$
init_recovers: Bidirectional EMA average at uniform mixture weights
diff_from_baseline: Versus dlinear/timesnet/patchtst this discards the deep temporal model entirely and instead fits a tiny per-pixel refiner on top of mask-aware mean/std normalization and three learned-rate forward+backward exponential propagations, fused by a softmax MLP. Output keeps observed entries verbatim.
